summary: Added newestVintage() and made the schema gate vintage-aware so two vintages of the same issuer can never be blended into one result.
reason: Unqualified queries across the penetration tables returned 24 rows for 16 issuers because two vintages were being unioned, which would double-count custody for any issuer present in both. newestVintage() pins reads to a single vintage. The schema gate also had to learn that a month legitimately arrives as two parts (A and B): comparing their column sets against each other reported false schema drift on every complete month, so parts are now reconciled within a vintage and a month missing one of its parts is refused outright rather than served short.
validated_outcome: The 16-issuer repro now returns 16 rows; parts A+B of 2025-11-30 pass the schema gate; a deliberately half-loaded month is refused.
